full_judgment: 4. It is stated in the revisional application that during the pendency of the Other Suit No. 11 of 2002 as well as application for a temporary injunction, the defendants Nos. 1 to 3 and 7 to 9 dispossessed the plaintiffs from the 'Kha' scheduled land forcibly on 3-5-2003 and as a result of which the plaintiffs sought for the relief for recovery of khas possession by way of amendment of the plaint.
